description: Cancel a rental. Unpaid: nothing is owed. Paid: a pro-rata refund of the unused paid time, per the Rental Terms (https://galaxymind.space/terms/rental), reviewed and sent manually; a full refund if the rigs never switched. While a custom pool awaits approval it answers awaiting_pool_approval: it can't be cancelled then, and it is refunded in full if not approved. Needs rental_id and creator_secret.

creator_secret.description: creatorSecret from create_rental. Shown once; keep it private.
